name: Schleifenbauer Generic (MIB)
description: Auto-compiled with libsmi from 1 MIB module(s). 243 readable OIDs under 1.3.6.1.4.1.44568.

oids.name: idDeviceName
oids.description: User configurable device name or identifier.

oids.name: idModuleType
oids.description: Device category: 0 = Daisychain Module, 1 = Gateway Module, 2 = Controller Module (SF also uses -1 to meaning no module!)

oids.name: idState
oids.description: The device state info as string

oids.name: idType
oids.description: The device type. e.g. PDU, UPS, etc

oids.name: configMaximumLoad
oids.description: Maximum rated load of the device per phase (this value is also mentioned on the PDU profile), usually either 16A, 32A or 63A.

oids.name: configCustomerName
oids.description: Custom 64 character name field for the customer.

oids.name: configLength
oids.description: Length of the device in millimeter.

oids.name: configNoBranches
oids.description: The number of branches available in the PDU, can be zero if no branches are available in the configuration.

oids.name: configNrOutlMeasured
oids.description: Number of measured outlets available in the PDU. If numbering of outlets used is non-contiguous: the highest outlet number is assumed as amount of measured outlets.

oids.name: configNoNeutral
oids.description: Use neutral current measurements if available: 0 = No neutral current measurement, 1 = Use neutral current measurement.

oids.name: configNrOutletsTotal
oids.description: Total number of outlets available in the PDU, including hardwired outlets without a switchmeasure module.

oids.name: configNrPhases
oids.description: Total number of inputs: either zero (for no input metering), one or three for a single or three phase system.

oids.name: configNrOutlSwitched
oids.description: Total number of switched outlets available. If the numbering of outlets used is non-contiguous: the highest outlet number is assumed as amount of switched outlets.

oids.name: configNoTotals
oids.description: The number of total calculations available in the PDU, this is usually one but can be more.

oids.name: configVoltRating
oids.description: Voltage rating in V for this PDU.

oids.name: setCurrentDropDetection
oids.description: Enable or disable current drop detection (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled)

oids.name: setFixedOutletDelay
oids.description: Minimal delay between relay switch requests in milliseconds. The minimum delay is 100ms.

oids.name: setHighlight
oids.description: Locate a unit. Set to '1' to switch on and to '0' to switch off this function.

oids.name: setLedBrightness
oids.description: LED brightness setting for the light ring of a PDU

oids.name: setDisableOutletSwitching
oids.description: Setting this will disable all means of switching an outlet; only the powerup modes and delays will be respected (0 = disabled, 1 = enabled).

oids.name: setOutletPowerupMode
oids.description: Behaviour of outlets on power-up. 0 = off, 1 = same state as at power down use default switch delay, 2 = same state, but delayed by individual delay timer, 3 = Outlets will always stay on (even at ...

oids.name: setSensorChangeAlertMode
oids.description: Enables the sensor channel change detection. 0 = off (default), 1 = on

oids.name: dChainBreakLocation
oids.description: Device index of the ring break location. Can be used to determine between which devices the ring is broken.

oids.name: dChainBusStatus
oids.description: SPBUS network architecture configuration. 0 = open ring network, 1 = closed ring network

oids.name: dChainNrUnitsFound
oids.description: Result of scan command, denotes the number of devices on the SPBUS network.

oids.name: dChainUnitList
oids.description: List of unit addresses known to the device. Position ordered list of assigned unit addresses.

oids.name: resetRestart
oids.description: Writing '1' to this register will invoke a warm restart of the device. Note that this will have no effect on outlet status!

oids.name: inputName
oids.description: User configurable 64 character naming of the inputs or phases.

oids.name: inputEnergyTotal
oids.description: Either the only phase in a single phase measurement; or one of the three phases in a multiphase measurement. This value is not resetable.

oids.name: inputEnergySubtotal
oids.description: kWh subtotal register of the only phase in a single phase measurement; or one of three phases in a multiphase measurement.

oids.name: inputActivePower
oids.description: Input power (in W) x100, MEASURED by the device using current, voltage, and power factor measurements of a phase.

oids.name: inputApparentPower
oids.description: Input VA (volt-amps, in VA) 100x, MEASURED by the device using current and voltage measurements of a phase.

oids.name: inputReactivePower
oids.description: Reactive power (volt-amps reactive, in VAR) 100x, MEASURED by the device.

oids.name: inputPowerFactor
oids.description: The effective power factor for each input 100x.

oids.name: inputActualCurrent
oids.description: Actual apparent, RMS current of an input 100x.

oids.name: inputApparentEnergy
oids.description: The apparent accumulated energy VAh of each phase 100x.

oids.name: inputCrestFactor
oids.description: The crest factor per input 100x. the ratio of peak values to the effective value.

oids.name: inputPeakCurrent
oids.description: Input peak apparent 100x, RMS current; highest value since last reset of the peaks.

oids.name: inputMaxRatedAmps
oids.description: Maximum rated current in A per input.

oids.name: inputThd
oids.description: Total harmonic distortion in percent per phase 100x.

oids.name: inputMinVoltage
oids.description: RMS voltage dip; lowest value since reset of dips.

oids.name: inputMaxVoltage
oids.description: RMS voltage peak; highest value since reset of peaks.

oids.name: inputPhase
oids.description: A mapping to which phase each input is connected to.

oids.name: outletName
oids.description: User configurable naming of individual outlets.

oids.name: outletEnergyTotal
oids.description: Total kWh of selected outlet. This value is not resetable.

oids.name: outletEnergySubtotal
oids.description: kWh subtotal register of selected output.

oids.name: outletActivePower
oids.description: Output power (in W), MEASURED by the device x100 using current, voltage, and power factor measurements of an outlet.

oids.name: outletApparentPower
oids.description: Output VA (volt-amps, in VA) 100x, MEASURED by the device using current and voltage measurements of an outlet.

oids.name: outletReactivePower
oids.description: Reactive power (volt-amps reactive, in VAR) 100x, MEASURED by the device.

oids.name: outletActualCurrent
oids.description: Actual apparent 100x, RMS current per outlet.

oids.name: outletType
oids.description: Outlet types: 0: Unknown, 1: BS, 2: C13, 3: C13 IEC Lock, 4: C19, 5: C19 IEC Lock, 6: CEE 16A 1 phase, 7: CEE 16A 3 phase, 8: CEE 32A 1 phase, 9: CEE 32A 3 phase, 10: CEE 63A 1 phase, 11: CEE 63A 3...

oids.name: outletPhase
oids.description: A mapping to which input each outlet is connected to.

oids.name: outletCurrentState
oids.description: The state of the outlet relay(s).

oids.name: outletApparentEnergy
oids.description: The apparent accumulated energy VAh of each outlet 100x.

oids.name: outletCrestFactor
oids.description: The crest factor per outlet 100x. the ratio of peak values to the effective value.

oids.name: outletPeakCurrent
oids.description: Peak apparent 100x, RMS current of an outlet; highest value since last reset of the peaks.

oids.name: outletMaxRatedAmps
oids.description: Outlet maximum rated current in A.

oids.name: outletPowerCycle
oids.description: Writing '1' will cause the outlet to power cycle.

oids.name: outletPowerCycleDelay
oids.description: Outlet individual power cycle timer. This is the amount, in seconds.

oids.name: outletSwitchDelay
oids.description: Delay before an individual outlet's relay switches on at power-up, in seconds.

oids.name: outletBranch
oids.description: A mapping to which branch each outlet is connected to.

oids.name: branchName
oids.description: User configurable naming of a branch in 64 characters per branch.

oids.name: branchEnergyTotal
oids.description: Branch energy total measurement in kWh. This value is not resetable. 24-bit little-endian integer.

oids.name: branchEnergySubtotal
oids.description: Branch energy subtotal measurement in kWh. Reset to zero with [rsbmks]. 24-bit little-endian integer.

oids.name: branchActivePower
oids.description: Branch power (in W) x100, MEASURED by the device using current, voltage, and power factor measurements of an branch.

oids.name: branchApparentPower
oids.description: Branch VA (volt-amps) 100x, MEASURED by the device using current and voltage measurements of an branch.

oids.name: branchReactivePower
oids.description: Reactive power (volt-amps reactive, in VAR) of a branch x100, MEASURED by the device.

oids.name: branchPowerFactor
oids.description: The effective power factor per branch 100x.

oids.name: branchActualCurrent
oids.description: Actual apparent 100x, RMS current of a branch.

oids.name: branchActualVoltage
oids.description: The actual voltage per branch x100.

oids.name: branchType
oids.description: Breaker type: 0: Unknown, 1: ETA (thermal, resettable), 2: HYMA (hydraulic magnetic), 3: MCB (thermal magnetic DIN), 4: MELT (small ceramic fuse), 5: REVOLVER (large ceramic fuse, DIN holder).

oids.name: branchPhase
oids.description: A mapping to which phase (input) each branch is connected to.

oids.name: branchState
oids.description: Power state of the branch, usable for determining if a branch is currently tripped. 0 = OK, 1 = Tripped.

oids.name: branchApparentEnergy
oids.description: The apparent accumulated energy VAh of each branch. 100x

oids.name: branchCrestFactor
oids.description: The crest factor per branch 100x. the ratio of peak values to the effective value.

oids.name: branchPeakCurrent
oids.description: Branch peak apparent 100x, RMS current; highest value since last reset of the peaks.

oids.name: branchMaxRatedAmps
oids.description: Maximum rated current in A per branch (representing the breakerfuse value).

oids.name: branchThd
oids.description: Total harmonic distortion in percent per branch x100.

oids.name: branchMinVoltage
oids.description: RMS voltage dip per branch; lowest value since reset of dips.

oids.name: branchMaxVoltage
oids.description: RMS voltage peak per branch; highest value since reset of peaks.

oids.name: totalEnergy
oids.description: Total energy measurement in kWh. This value is not resetable.

oids.name: totalActivePower
oids.description: Totals power (in W) 100x, sum of phases.

oids.name: totalApparentPower
oids.description: Totals VA (volt-amps, in VA) 100x, sum of phases.

oids.name: totalReactivePower
oids.description: Totals reactive power (volt-amps reactive, in VAR) 100x, sum of phases.

oids.name: totalActualCurrent
oids.description: System total actual apparent 100x, RMS current.

oids.name: totalApparentEnergy
oids.description: The total apparent energy in VAh 100x. This value is not resetable.

oids.name: totalPeakCurrent
oids.description: System total peak apparent 100x, RMS current; highest value since last reset of the peaks.

oids.name: totalNeutralCurrent
oids.description: Neutral current measurement 100x. This is the sum of the neutral measurents channels: (only in three phase configs, one channel for all except 63A, then there will be two).

oids.name: totalOvervoltageProtect
oids.description: Overvoltage protection module measurement (0 = OK, 1 = Overvoltage detected).

oids.name: sensorValue
oids.description: The sensor value 10x. E.g. a temperature of 25.7 C is passed as 257.

oids.name: digitalInputSerialNumber
oids.description: Serial number of the digital input.

oids.name: digitalOutputSerialNumber
oids.description: Serial number of the digital output.
